caption: The drawing depicts a single figure sitting on a curved, dark brown chair. The figure has an oversized head with exaggerated facial features including large, round eyes, a pronounced nose, and red markings around the cheeks and mouth. The figure wears a bonnet that is yellow and grey and appears textured. The body is clothed in a long, dark blue patterned dress decorated with red, white, and grey floral motifs, covering most of the torso and extending down to the ankles. Two wooden-colored hands are visible, one resting on the knee and the other on the hip. The legs are straight and extend downward, dressed in red stockings and ending in black shoes or boots. The background is an off-white, plain surface with no additional decorative elements. The bottom right corner of the image is signed with the name "ELMER WEISE."
title: Punch's Sweatheart
